item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently prescribes an amendment to codified federal regulations; the substantive legal amendment takes effect through this directive itself, rather than through a later agency decision.","evidence":"I hereby prescribe the following amendment of the regulations"},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently amends the regulation to impose a security-based condition on eligibility for merchant-vessel documentation and employment, while authorizing the Commandant to exempt vessel categories; the legal rule is established by this segment itself.","evidence":"No person shall be issued a document required for employment on a merchant vessel of the United States nor shall any person be employed on a merchant vessel of the United States unless the Commandant is satisfied"}]}
